Aarav Jain | aarav.jain780@example.com | +91 9845287010
Delhi NCR

Professional Summary
Senior Node.js developer with extensive experience building scalable backend services, APIs, and data-driven features for consumer and enterprise platforms. Strong focus on designing GraphQL schemas, optimizing MongoDB performance, and delivering production-ready Node.js systems on AWS. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, GraphQL, Redis, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior Node.js Developer, Ola (Jan 2018 - Present)
- Led design and implementation of GraphQL gateway consolidating multiple microservices, reducing frontend API calls by 60% and improving page load times; used Node.js and MongoDB for schema stitching and resolvers.
- Built high-throughput booking and fare calculation services in Node.js deployed on AWS autoscaling groups and Lambda, achieving 99.95% availability and handling peak traffic spikes with Redis-backed caches.
- Drove MongoDB schema refactor and indexing strategy that cut query latency by 40%; documented changes and runbooks in Confluence to standardize on-call practices.

Node.js Developer, Ledgerly (May 2016 - Dec 2017)
- Implemented GraphQL APIs for transaction and ledger querying, enabling complex client-side queries while maintaining strict access controls; integrated with AWS RDS and S3 for data storage.
- Developed background reconciliation jobs in Node.js running on AWS ECS with Redis for job coordination, improving reconciliation throughput by 3x.
- Authored GraphQL schema versioning approach and Confluence guides to streamline onboarding for new engineers.

Full Stack Developer, Helio Energy (May 2013 - Apr 2016)
- Built TypeScript-based Node.js services exposing GraphQL endpoints for energy monitoring dashboards; aggregated data into MongoDB and used Redis for caching frequently accessed metrics.
- Deployed end-to-end pipelines on AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFormation) and optimized ingestion paths to support near real-time analytics with sub-second GraphQL query responses.
- Collaborated on frontend-backend integration, using GraphQL to simplify data requirements and maintainability; documented APIs and deployment runbooks in Confluence.

Node.js Developer, Saffron Bank (Sep 2012 - Apr 2013)
- Implemented secure Node.js microservices exposing GraphQL interfaces for account and transaction lookups; ensured strict input validation and audit logging.
- Tuned MongoDB queries and used Redis for session and rate-limit storage, reducing query contention during peak banking hours.
- Created developer-facing Confluence documentation for API usage and security best practices.

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
